item: The legacy single-file restore checks the 2 GiB cap on the file's size before it reads the file
summary: restore_legacy_path called read_bytes() on the server-side path and _stage_upload refused an over-cap file only afterwards, so a larger file was held in memory first. The size the file system reports is now compared with the cap before a byte is read and an over-cap file is refused with the same 413 naming the volume set. Tested with a sparse file one byte over the cap and a read_bytes that fails if called (red without).
